rank_math.title: Emergency Window Board-Up Service in Toronto & the GTA | SolidGuard
rank_math.description: Emergency window board up for homes and storefronts across the GTA, day or night. We secure the opening after a break-in, storm, or accident, then replace the glass.

fields.hero_h1: Emergency Window Board-Up in Toronto and the GTA
fields.hero_subhead: Broken in, smashed, or storm-damaged? We board up the opening fast to secure your property, day or night, then come back with the glass.
fields.overview_heading: Secure the opening first, glass after
fields.overview_body:
After a break-in or smashed window, the first job is to secure the opening, not wait days for glass. SolidGuard provides emergency window board-up across Toronto and the GTA, day or night. A same-day window board up secures the window or storefront with cut plywood, makes the property safe and weather-tight, and books the glass to follow.

Need to board up window glass after a break-in? A fast board-up stops further loss, keeps the weather and intruders out, and buys time to source the right glass. We handle post-break-in, vandalism, storm, and accident damage for homes and businesses, and we document everything for your insurance. Once the glass is cut to size, we return, remove the board, and finish the repair.

faqs.question: How fast can you board up my window?
faqs.answer: We aim to reach most GTA properties the same day, day or night. Call and we will give you a realistic arrival window and secure the opening as soon as we are on site.

faqs.question: Do you board up and replace the glass, or just board up?
faqs.answer: Both. We board up first to secure the opening immediately, then return with the glass cut to size once it is ready, and finish the repair.

faqs.question: Do you board up storefronts as well as homes?
faqs.answer: Yes. Emergency board up service covers homes and businesses, including smashed storefronts and commercial entrances.

faqs.question: Will the board-up keep the weather out?
faqs.answer: Yes. We fit cut plywood to secure the opening and keep wind, rain, and intruders out until the glass is replaced.

faqs.question: Can you help with my insurance claim?
faqs.answer: Yes. We document the damage and the work, including the board-up and the glass replacement, so you have what you need for your insurer.

faqs.question: Do you cover the whole GTA, after hours?
faqs.answer: Yes, across Toronto and the GTA, day or night, with police-cleared technicians.
